verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a dedicated facet search endpoint that is 'typically used to power auto-complete and type-ahead interfaces', but only over the values of a single facet in filter menus, not general query suggestions. Analytics tracks search queries, yet nothing shows that data feeding suggestions. Missing for 10: query suggestions generated from real search traffic, a documented suggestions-index pattern or feature, autocomplete beyond facet values, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
